description: This file defines the IdempotencyStoreBatchFilter class which implements batch filtering logic in the Apache Fineract project. It handles extracting idempotency keys from batch requests, setting request context attributes, and storing command results based on response status.

classes.name: IdempotencyStoreBatchFilter
classes.description: A Spring component that filters batch requests to handle idempotency by extracting keys, setting request context, and storing command results.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Main filter method that processes the batch request, extracts idempotency key, sets context attribute, proceeds with chain, and conditionally stores command results.

methods.name: extractIdempotentKeyFromBatchRequest
methods.description: Private helper that extracts the idempotency key from the batch request headers based on configured header name.
